title: Does `research-finding` own anything irreducible, or is it a projection?
statement: Is there state a research-finding artifact would hold that is not already held by evidence(kind: source), assertion, or question — and that something downstream must traverse (#41)?
notes: SECOND PARTIAL RESULT, 2026-08-18 — a READING-based stage 3 was run (QST-0004, the Next.js debt), which is the case the first result said was missing. It still needed no research-finding. Source inventory: three evidence(kind: source) records, each carrying its citations in evidence.sources. Claims: three assertions, each scoped by targetEnvironment to the mode it is about. ⚠️ CONTRADICTORY SOURCES WERE ENCOUNTERED — the case this type's strongest argument rests on. Two pages of the SAME official documentation give the same operation opposite treatment: the previous-model guide says pages in development are never cached, while the Cache Components page says a synchronous fs read is a predictable value prerendered into the static shell. ⚠️ AND THE CONTRADICTION DISSOLVED RATHER THAN NEEDING A HOME. The two sources do not disagree; they describe two different modes. Scoping each assertion's targetEnvironment by cacheComponents enabled/disabled resolved it completely — which is what targetEnvironment is for, and it is the same move that fixed AST-0003. So 'contradictory sources resolved or surfaced' was satisfied by SCOPING THE CLAIMS, not by a narrative artifact. Still not conclusive: this contradiction was RESOLVABLE. A genuine unresolved disagreement between authorities — two sources making incompatible claims about the SAME configuration — has not yet been met, and that remains the one case research-finding might own. Remains unanswered, with the evidence against it now covering both the experimental and the documentary half of stage 3. ⚠️ DEFERRED 2026-08-24 by pm — NOT ANSWERED, and the distinction is the whole point. `research-finding` is deactivated for this project on demonstrated absence of demand, which records "no project demand today" rather than "the type has no value". The evidence still FAVOURS projection and does not establish it: what has never been met is a genuinely IRRECONCILABLE disagreement — two authorities making incompatible claims about the SAME configuration — and the one contradiction this project did encounter dissolved under `targetEnvironment` scoping rather than needing a home. ⚠️ REOPENING CONDITIONS, either of which reactivates the type and returns this question to open work: (a) an irreconcilable same-configuration conflict between authorities; (b) a downstream consumer requiring state not carried by `assertion`, `evidence` or `question`. ⚠️ `monitored` was deliberately NOT added to `resolution` (pm, 2026-08-24): monitoring is workflow policy, not a resolution outcome. If triggers later need structured representation they get their own `revisitWhen` field rather than a fourth enum value mixing two axes into one — the same split-first rule that keeps `resolution` off the envelope (#107).
